dialogue.title: Ana’s change of plans
dialogue.subtitle: Listen and read with your teacher, then answer the questions

lines.en: How was your weekend in Ilhabela?
lines.pt: Como foi seu fim de semana em Ilhabela?

lines.en: It was great in the end. Leo and I were planning to spend Sunday on the beach
lines.pt: No fim, foi ótimo. Leo e eu estávamos planejando passar o domingo na praia

lines.en: In the end? Did something go wrong?
lines.pt: No fim? Alguma coisa deu errado?

lines.en: Yes, it rained all morning, so we ended up in a little café
lines.pt: Sim, choveu a manhã toda, então acabamos em um pequeno café

lines.en: That sounds nice. What was the best part?
lines.pt: Parece legal. Qual foi a melhor parte?

lines.en: The weather got better, and we took a boat trip along the coast. The view was amazing
lines.pt: O tempo melhorou, e fizemos um passeio de barco pelo litoral. A vista era incrível

lines.en: So you made the most of it. What would you do differently next time?
lines.pt: Então vocês aproveitaram o melhor possível. O que você faria diferente na próxima vez?

lines.en: I’d check the weather before leaving! But I’d definitely go back
lines.pt: Eu verificaria a previsão do tempo antes de sair! Mas com certeza voltaria

questions.answer: She planned to spend Sunday on the beach

questions.prompt: Why did Ana and Leo go to a café?
What would Ana do differently next time?
questions.answer: She’d check the weather before leaving
